newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PT Indocement to sell PT Indofood stake.
newsitem.headline: PT Indocement to sell PT Indofood stake.

text.p: PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa said on Tuesday it proposed a spinoff and sale of its 50.1 percent shareholding in PT Indofood Sukses Makmur to shareholders and to a new purchaser.

The proposed spinoff is expected to be effected by the distribution of 724.34 million Indofood shares representing 39.56 percent of Indofood share capital to shareholders of Indocement in the form of special dividend.
There will also be a sale of 193.10 million Indofood shares representing 10.54 percent of the company to private companies held by Indonesia's Sampoerna family, Indocement said in a statement.

"The separation of the cement and food businesses will give shareholders the flexibility to hold investments in pure cement and food products business separately. The company believes this will unlock value for Indocement shareholders," it said.
It also said the Salim group would retain control of Indofood after its spinoff through a majority shareholding in Singapore listed QAF Ltd.
QAF has proposed buying a majority stake in Indofood.
Anthony Salim, president and chief executive officer of the Salim group and vice president and director of Indocement said:

"This restructuring is another step in the group's streamlining that began with the sale of Bogasari to Indofood in 1995 and continued with the sale of related food businesses to Indofood in March this year."
